report.head: 822b51fb2bb3eaa59d60a109097cc3575e6373d3
checked: GET /bankAccounts/:bankAccountId as the account owner (control, succeeds) and as a distinct authenticated seeded user who is not the owner (bank-account-isolation)

GET /transactions/:transactionId for a seeded private-privacyLevel transaction as sender and receiver participants (control, both succeed) and as a distinct authenticated seeded user who is not a participant (private-transaction-isolation)

Reviewed backend/user-routes.ts GET /:userId which correctly enforces ensureAuthenticated plus an explicit req.user.id equality check and returns 401 Unauthorized for other users (account-isolation already enforced)

Reviewed backend/bankaccount-routes.ts and backend/transaction-routes.ts source and backend/database.ts getBankAccountById/getTransactionByIdForApi to confirm neither filters by requesting user before responding
skipped: External identity providers (Auth0/Okta/Cognito/Google) and their login flows
Production PostgreSQL/persistence-backed storage and avatar/object storage routes
unexpected-server-error, protected-route and feed-pagination catalog oracles were not separately probed this session
POST/PATCH/DELETE mutation endpoints and their authorization (bankTransfers, likes, comments, contacts, notifications bulk)
UI/Cypress journeys beyond the two API isolation proposals

findings.title: GET /bankAccounts/:bankAccountId discloses any user's bank account to any authenticated user
findings.summary: backend/bankaccount-routes.ts calls getBankAccountById(bankAccountId) without checking it belongs to req.user. Executed proposal bank-account-isolation.api.test.cjs (batch 1) confirmed the owner can read their own seeded account (control, 200), then logged in as a distinct unrelated seeded user and received 200 with the owner's full bank account record instead of a denial.

findings.title: GET /transactions/:transactionId discloses private transactions to non-participants
findings.summary: backend/transaction-routes.ts calls getTransactionByIdForApi(transactionId) with no participant check. Executed proposal private-transaction-isolation.api.test.cjs (batch 3) confirmed both the sender and receiver can read a seeded privacyLevel:private transaction (control, both 200), then logged in as a distinct seeded user who is neither sender nor receiver and received 200 with the full private transaction record instead of a denial.
